newsitem.title: USA: Market Guide Inc launches new Web site.
newsitem.headline: Market Guide Inc launches new Web site.

text.p: Market Guide Inc said Wednesday it has launched its redesigned Web site, which includes research reports on publicly-traded companies, stock screening applications, stock quotes, price and volume charts, news and SEC filings.
Market Guide said that it created several of its re-designed sites jointly with other Internet vendors, including PC Quote Inc, Financial Insight Systems, News Alert and EDGAR-Online.
The company said its quotes, charts, news and historical SEC filings will be offered free to visitors and subscribers of the site.
Market Guide compiles a database containing descriptive and financial information on publicly traded companies.
